dataset: SAFE-Loop Authentication and secrets set (hard) v0.2
test_layout: 12 tests per task; tests 1-6 = visible pool, tests 7-12 = fixed hidden set; all tests are labelled hard; visible tests are not shown to the model when runner uses k=0.
notes: Authentication and secrets benchmark with 20 tasks AUT-001..AUT-020. The original five uploaded tasks are retained; 15 new tasks were added. All tests are labelled hard, use positional args, and use returns/ValueError expectations. New tests have deterministic expected outputs generated from local specifications; independent implementations were used to cross-check the paired algorithmic tasks, and RFC 4226 HOTP / RFC 5869 HKDF known vectors were checked. Dataset structure was validated. This does not prove that any target LLM fails or achieves less than a 50% task pass rate; that must be measured with real runs. No reference_solution field is included.

tasks.title: JWT verification (HMAC)
tasks.signature: def jwt_verify_hs(token: str, secret_hex: str, now: int, expected_aud: str, expected_iss: str) -> dict
tasks.prompt: Write `jwt_verify_hs(token, secret_hex, now, expected_aud, expected_iss)` that verifies a JSON Web Token signed with HS256, HS384 or HS512 (RFC 7519, RFC 7515, RFC 8725) under the key given as hex, at Unix time `now`, and returns the payload as a dict. Raise `ValueError` if the token must not be accepted.

tasks.title: MD5-based crypt (md5-crypt and apr1)
tasks.signature: def md5_crypt(password: str, salt: str, magic: str) -> str
tasks.prompt: Write `md5_crypt(password, salt, magic)` returning the full MD5-based crypt hash string as stored in /etc/shadow (`$1$`) and in Apache htpasswd files (`$apr1$`); `magic` selects the variant and is either `$1$` or `$apr1$`. The password is UTF-8. Implement it yourself with hashlib.md5 only; do not call crypt, passlib or openssl. Raise `ValueError` for any other magic.

args: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

tasks.title: SHA-256/SHA-512 crypt
tasks.signature: def sha_crypt(password: str, setting: str) -> str
tasks.prompt: Write `sha_crypt(password, setting)` that behaves like crypt(3) for the SHA-256 (`$5$`) and SHA-512 (`$6$`) password schemes in Drepper's "Unix crypt using SHA-256 and SHA-512" specification, and returns the full hash string. The password is UTF-8. Implement it yourself with hashlib's plain hash functions only; do not call crypt, passlib or openssl. Raise `ValueError` for any other scheme.

tasks.title: AWS Signature Version 4 signature
tasks.signature: def sigv4_signature(method: str, path: str, query: str, headers: list, body_hex: str, secret_key: str, amz_date: str, region: str, service: str) -> str
tasks.prompt: Write `sigv4_signature(method, path, query, headers, body_hex, secret_key, amz_date, region, service)` returning the hex AWS Signature Version 4 signature (AWS4-HMAC-SHA256) of a request for a non-S3 service. `path` and `query` are as written in the request line, `headers` is a list of [name, value] pairs that are all signed, and `body_hex` is the request body as hex. Raise `ValueError` for input that cannot be signed.

tasks.title: WebAuthn authenticator data parser
tasks.signature: def parse_authenticator_data(data_hex: str) -> list
tasks.prompt: Write `parse_authenticator_data(data_hex)` for the WebAuthn authenticator data structure (W3C Web Authentication, section 6.1). Return `[rp_id_hash_hex, flags, sign_count, credential_id_hex, extensions_hex]`, with `credential_id_hex` and `extensions_hex` None when absent and `extensions_hex` being the raw CBOR bytes as hex. Raise `ValueError` for malformed data.

tasks.title: HOTP counter-based one-time password
tasks.signature: def hotp(secret_hex: str, counter: int, digits: int, algorithm: str) -> str
tasks.prompt: Implement RFC 4226 counter-based one-time passwords using SHA-1, SHA-256, or SHA-512 as selected by `algorithm`. Return the zero-padded code; reject invalid counters, encodings, or unsupported digit widths.

tasks.title: TOTP drift-window verifier
tasks.signature: def totp_verify(secret_hex: str, now: int, code: str, digits: int, period: int, window: int, algorithm: str) -> int
tasks.prompt: Implement TOTP verification using RFC 6238 and RFC 4226. Return the matching counter within ±`window`, preferring the smallest absolute offset and then the lower counter; reject malformed codes or unsupported parameters.

tasks.title: HKDF-SHA256 extract-and-expand
tasks.signature: def hkdf_sha256(ikm_hex: str, salt_hex: str, info_hex: str, length: int) -> str
tasks.prompt: Implement HKDF-SHA256 from RFC 5869 using hexadecimal byte strings. Return exactly `length` bytes as lowercase hex and reject invalid input or lengths outside the specification.

tasks.title: HTTP Digest authentication response
tasks.signature: def digest_response(username: str, password: str, realm: str, nonce: str, method: str, uri: str, qop: str, nc: str, cnonce: str, algorithm: str, entity_hex: str) -> str
tasks.prompt: Compute the HTTP Digest response value for RFC 7616 with the supplied credentials, request, qop and algorithm. Return lowercase hexadecimal; raise ValueError for unsupported or malformed parameters.

tasks.title: Strict HTTP Basic Authorization parser
tasks.signature: def parse_basic_auth(headers: list) -> dict
tasks.prompt: Parse the HTTP Basic Authorization field according to RFC 7617, using strict canonical Base64 and UTF-8 credentials. Return a username/password mapping; raise ValueError for ambiguous, malformed, or invalid fields.

tasks.title: RFC 7638 JWK thumbprint
tasks.signature: def jwk_thumbprint(jwk_text: str) -> str
tasks.prompt: Compute the base64url SHA-256 JWK thumbprint as specified by RFC 7638 for supported RSA, EC, OKP, and octet-key JWKs. Reject duplicate JSON members and missing or malformed required members.

tasks.title: OAuth 2.0 PKCE verifier validation
tasks.signature: def verify_pkce(verifier: str, method: str, challenge: str) -> bool
tasks.prompt: Validate a Proof Key for Code Exchange pair according to RFC 7636. Support the `plain` and `S256` methods and return True only for a valid matching pair.

tasks.title: WebAuthn clientDataJSON verification
tasks.signature: def verify_client_data(raw_json: str, expected_type: str, expected_challenge: str, expected_origin: str) -> dict
tasks.prompt: Validate a WebAuthn clientDataJSON object against the expected ceremony type, challenge, and origin. Reject duplicate JSON keys, invalid JSON constants, and disallowed cross-origin values.

tasks.title: Canonical DER single-TLV parser
tasks.signature: def parse_der_tlv(data_hex: str) -> dict
tasks.prompt: Parse exactly one ASN.1 DER tag-length-value item. Return its tag octets, constructed bit, value bytes as hex, and total encoded length; reject non-canonical or truncated encodings.

tasks.title: Strict PEM armor decoder
tasks.signature: def parse_pem(pem_text: str, expected_label: str) -> list
tasks.prompt: Parse one strict RFC 7468-style PEM block and return `[label, data_hex]`. Require 64-character Base64 lines except for the final line, canonical Base64, matching labels, and no additional blocks or surrounding text.

args:
-----BEGIN RSA PUBLIC KEY-----
AP8=
-----END RSA PUBLIC KEY-----

-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----
YWJj
-----END EC PRIVATE KEY-----

-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----
YQ==
-----END PUBLIC KEY-----
-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----
Yg==
-----END PUBLIC KEY-----

tasks.title: Timestamp-bound HMAC webhook signature
tasks.signature: def verify_webhook(secret_hex: str, timestamp_header: str, body_hex: str, signature_header: str, now: int, tolerance: int) -> bool
tasks.prompt: Verify a timestamp-bound HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature over `timestamp + '.' + raw_body` with a bounded clock tolerance. The separate decimal `timestamp_header` must match the `t=` value in `signature_header`; accept one or more v1 signatures and reject malformed, stale, or mismatching headers.

tasks.title: Session Set-Cookie parser with prefix invariants
tasks.signature: def parse_session_cookie(line: str) -> dict
tasks.prompt: Parse one Set-Cookie field into its name, value, and normalized attributes. Enforce the `__Host-`, `__Secure-`, and SameSite=None security invariants; reject malformed quoting and duplicate attributes.

tasks.title: OpenSSH public-key wire parser
tasks.signature: def parse_ssh_public_key(line: str) -> dict
tasks.prompt: Parse an authorized_keys-format Ed25519 or RSA public-key line and validate its SSH wire encoding (RFC 4253 / RFC 8709). Return the algorithm, public components as hex, and optional comment; reject malformed or non-canonical key blobs.

tasks.title: WWW-Authenticate challenge parser
tasks.signature: def parse_www_authenticate(value: str) -> list
tasks.prompt: Parse a WWW-Authenticate field containing one or more authentication challenges, including token68 credentials and quoted auth parameters. Preserve challenge order and reject malformed or duplicate parameters.

tasks.title: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 password record verifier
tasks.signature: def verify_pbkdf2_record(password: str, record: str) -> bool
tasks.prompt: Verify a password against the `$pbkdf2-sha256$iterations$salt$derived-key` record format. Require 1,000–1,000,000 iterations, an 8–64 byte salt, and a 32-byte derived key; decode canonical Base64 and reject malformed records.
